previousRule: The live staff page shows an eligible code button, but its POST rejects a browser form as Invalid request. The guard compares Origin with the runtime URL, which can differ from the public alias used by the browser.
newRule: The code-issue POST validates the public staff host and browser Origin or same-origin Fetch Metadata, retains URL-encoded form and size limits, and still requires a SUPPLIER_ADMIN session and fresh customer eligibility checks. The staff page displays fabric names and message previews without em dashes while preserving catalogue data.
reason: The owner asked to issue sample follow-up codes through the live staff page. The first authorised form submission returned Invalid request and the private ledgers stayed empty. The correction keeps cross-site submissions blocked while accepting the public alias form.
ownerApprovedDecision: Owner review is requested for the corrected staff code form and protected test. The repository requires an exact-head Nylon1 comment on this PR before merge; this field does not substitute for that comment.
